titulo.alumno:
«Страдательная форма и неопределённый деятель»
Passive and unspecified agent

intro: In informative texts the agent can be omitted with строится, построили or построено; each form focuses on process, action or result.

piezas.titulo: In informative texts the agent can be omitted with строится, построили or построено; each form focuses on process, action or result.
texto: In informative texts the agent can be omitted with строится, построили or построено; each form focuses on process, action or result.
They do not always equal the Spanish passive: identify whether the text stresses the process, the result or who acted.

frases.alumno: They are building a new health centre in the district.

frases.estudio: Новое здание было открыто в прошлом году.
frases.alumno: The new building was opened last year.

pregunta.texto: Which sentence presents the process in progress?

opciones.explicacion: Строят presents an action in progress with an unspecified agent.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «В районе строят новую поликлинику.»

opciones.texto: They are building a new health centre in the district.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: The new building was opened last year.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.
